Secondary objective  Evaluate whether the vaccine recipients experience increased risk of AESI post-vaccination.  Estimate the incidence rates of AESI among subcohorts of interest such as women of childbearing age, immunocompromised people, and stratified by age. Characterize utilization patterns of vaccine in subcohorts of interest such as women of childbearing age, immunocompromised, and within age categories.
